sentences.en: We were amazed at the excellence of the boy's drawings.
sentences.zh: 我们对那个男孩画得这么好感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I am constantly amazed at the energy of my grandparents.
sentences.zh: 我经常被祖父母的能量所震撼。

sentences.en: It amazed us to hear that things were so cheap.
sentences.zh: 听到那些东西这么便宜，我们都感到很惊讶。
